title: Gateway hostname
body: The gateway hostname is portainer; it answers on port 8443.

title: Deploys
body: Deploys run through argocd using the gitops-manifests repo.

title: Container registry
body: Push container images to registryhost with the latest tag.

title: Primary database
body: The database is pg-primary; it listens on port 5432.

title: Nightly backups
body: Nightly backups run with restic into the vaultbucket.

title: Secrets
body: Secrets live in hashivault under secret/llmphant.

title: CI pipeline
body: CI runs on forgejo with docker-linux runners.

title: Monitoring
body: Metrics flow through prometheus and grafana dashboards.

title: news-kb overview
body: news-kb spans several ingest and embedding repos.

title: newsapi
body: newsapi ingests headlines into the warehouse.

title: go_news
body: go_news crawls RSS feeds using goroutines.

title: llm-embedder
body: llm-embedder batches embeddings over grpc.

title: TypingMind bridge
body: TypingMind speaks to llmphant through the mcp server.

title: Code search
body: Prefer ripgrep for code search instead of grepping.

title: Test command
body: Run cargo test locked; the suite needs no network.

title: Node inventory
body: Enumerate cluster nodes with mpssh hostname.

title: Task runner
body: Fan out tasks through a justfile.

title: Terse notes
body: Fragments beat prose; trim on every edit.

title: No dates
body: Store no dates, history or emphasis in notes.

title: Commit style
body: Commit messages use conventional prefixes such as feat and fix.

title: Broker account
body: Broker holdings sync from a nightly ledger import.

title: Budget sheet
body: Budget lives in the sheet ledger2026.

title: Movie night
body: Friday movie night rotates through criterion picks.

title: Camera gear
body: Camera body is a fujifilm with a 35mm lens.
